设计意图： Crossover of qualified parent1 (volume-adjusted breakout with downside risk filter) and rejected parent2 (10-day momentum with volume weight). Preserve parent1's core breakout and low-risk filter, but replace daily return with 10-day return from parent2 to capture longer trend momentum, aiming to improve IC while maintaining the strong RankICIR from parent1.

📝 计算步骤（一步一步解释）

  1. 计算 ret_10：close.pct_change(10)
  2. 计算 vol_ratio：volume / volume.滚动窗口(20, min_periods=20).mean()
  3. 计算 highest_high：high.滚动窗口(20, min_periods=20).max().shift(1)
  4. 计算 breakout：close > highest_high
  5. 计算 ret_daily：close.pct_change()
  6. 计算 neg_ret：ret_daily.where(ret_daily < 0, 0)
  7. 计算 pos_ret：ret_daily.where(ret_daily > 0, 0)
  8. 计算 neg_vol：neg_ret.滚动窗口(20, min_periods=10).std(ddof=1)
  9. 计算 pos_vol：pos_ret.滚动窗口(20, min_periods=10).std(ddof=1)
  10. 计算 vol_ratio_risk：neg_vol / pos_vol
  11. 计算 vol_ratio_risk：np.log(vol_ratio_risk.clip(lower=1e-12))
  12. 计算 vol_risk_median：vol_ratio_risk.滚动窗口(20, min_periods=20).median()
  13. 计算 low_risk：vol_ratio_risk < vol_risk_median
  14. 计算 coherence_signal：(breakout & (vol_ratio > 1) & low_risk) * ret_10 * vol_ratio
  15. 计算 factor：coherence_signal.滚动窗口(5).sum()
⚠ 该因子原始 IC 为负，已整体取反（×(-1)）调正方向；下列步骤展示的是原始公式的计算过程。

  2. log(neg_std/pos_std) — log(x) → 自然对数
  3. log(neg_std/pos_std) — log(x) → 自然对数

🐍 原始 Python 代码 (factor_delivery)

"kw">class="kw">def factor_volume_adjusted_breakout_with_vol_filter_v2(df): df_copy = df.copy() ret_10 = df_copy["str">'close'].pct_change(10) vol_ratio = df_copy["str">'volume'] / df_copy["str">'volume'].rolling(20, min_periods=20).mean() highest_high = df_copy["str">'high'].rolling(20, min_periods=20).max().shift(1) breakout = df_copy["str">'close'] > highest_high ret_daily = df_copy["str">'close'].pct_change() neg_ret = ret_daily.where(ret_daily < 0, 0) pos_ret = ret_daily.where(ret_daily > 0, 0) neg_vol = neg_ret.rolling(20, min_periods=10).std(ddof=1) pos_vol = pos_ret.rolling(20, min_periods=10).std(ddof=1) vol_ratio_risk = neg_vol / pos_vol.replace(0, np.nan) vol_ratio_risk = np.log(vol_ratio_risk.clip(lower=1e-12)) vol_risk_median = vol_ratio_risk.rolling(20, min_periods=20).median() low_risk = vol_ratio_risk < vol_risk_median coherence_signal = (breakout & (vol_ratio > 1) & low_risk) * ret_10 * vol_ratio factor = coherence_signal.rolling(5).sum() factor.name = "str">'factor_volume_adjusted_breakout_with_vol_filter_v2' "kw">class="kw">return factor
